north_star: An agent-development agent (meta-agent) that designs AND builds other agents, producing the highest-quality, verifiably-correct code using best-known practices.

delta_from_agentagent1.agentagent1_was: A phased design-document generator. Output = JSON design specs. No code execution, no verification, no tools beyond reasoning.
delta_from_agentagent1.agentagent2_is: A full agent-engineering pipeline. Output = validated design + runnable, tested, linted, typed agent code. Adds tools, skills, MCP, sandboxed environments, verification loops, subagent orchestration, and evaluation.
key_shifts: single reasoning loop -> orchestrated multi-phase loop with quality gates
no tools -> curated least-privilege tool suite + MCP servers
implicit quality -> explicit evaluation harness for produced agents

gates.VERIFY: hard gate: format+lint+typecheck+tests+coverage must pass before DELIVER
gates.EVALUATE: produced agent must pass its eval suite above threshold

framework.output_contract: Every phase emits JSON validated against a published JSON Schema; DELIVER also emits runnable files.

features.name: Dual-mode operation (Design + Build)
features.summary: Runs as a spec generator OR a full builder that emits runnable, tested agent code; mode is selectable and can escalate from design to build.

features.name: Phased loop with quality gates
features.summary: Nine-phase pipeline where VERIFY and EVALUATE are hard gates that block delivery of unproven code.

features.name: Least-privilege tool suite
features.summary: Curated tools (file read/write/edit, shell, code search, web, VCS, test runner, package manager) with permission scoping and audit logging.

features.name: Agent-building Skills library
features.summary: Reusable, model-invoked playbooks in Agent-Skills format (SKILL.md + scripts) for scaffolding, tool design, prompt engineering, evals, quality gates, MCP, orchestration, memory, safety.

features.name: MCP integration layer
features.summary: Standardized external capabilities via Model Context Protocol servers (filesystem, git/github, fetch, browser, database, memory) with a declarative manifest.

features.name: Coding-style engine
features.summary: Language-agnostic quality core + concrete style templates (Python, TS/JS, Go, Rust, Bash) enforced by formatter/linter/type-checker/tests with coverage thresholds.

features.name: Subagent orchestration
features.summary: Spawns specialized subagents (researcher, architect, coder, reviewer, tester) with self-contained briefs and result synthesis.

features.name: Context & memory management
features.summary: Plan file, scratchpad, external artifact store, and compaction policy to survive long builds within context limits.

features.name: Evaluation harness
features.summary: Generates and runs an eval suite for every produced agent (task success, tool-call correctness, safety, regression) with a scoreboard.

features.name: Sandboxed reproducible environments
features.summary: Containerized, network-scoped, reproducible dev environment (devcontainer/lockfiles) so builds and verifications are deterministic.

features.name: Safety & guardrails
features.summary: Least privilege, secrets hygiene, destructive-action confirmation, prompt-injection resistance, and provenance/audit trail.

features.name: Structured output + schemas
features.summary: Published JSON Schemas for plan/design/tool-manifest/eval so all artifacts are machine-validatable and diffable.

key_decisions.runtime: Claude models via an Agent-SDK-style harness with tool-use + MCP client support.
key_decisions.model_policy: Tiered: a strong 'architect/reviewer' model + a fast 'worker' model for bulk edits/search; escalation on gate failure.
key_decisions.autonomy_default: Plan-approval gate, then autonomous execution with mandatory VERIFY/EVALUATE gates before delivery.
key_decisions.deliverable: Both a validated JSON design AND a runnable, tested file scaffold.
key_decisions.quality_bar: No deliverable ships unless format+lint+typecheck+tests pass and eval score >= threshold.

risks.mitigation: YAGNI principle in style core; minimal viable agent first, extend on evidence.
F8 memory policy + subagent offloading + compaction.
F2 hard VERIFY gate + F9 evals.
